benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Get round-the-clock concierge assistance by calling the toll-free number 18002670731

benefitRows.name: Criblife concierge
benefitRows.offer: Cardholders can avail concierge support for sourcing tickets for events such as concerts, sporting events, lifestyle events, comedy shows and more across India and globally, restaurant bookings and recommendations worldwide, sourcing specific products as per customer requirements, hotel, villa, yacht and private jet reservations, designing, curating and arranging corporate or personal gifting, vehicle leasing and hire, complete travel and holiday planning with bookings, local advice through highly experienced consultants, and personalised shopping support including limited edition or ultra luxury items, antiques, home furnishings and more.|You can avail up to 6 services per year.
